title: Dugway 'grey beard': 'we had the triangles out again last night'
summary: UAPGerb tells of Dugway 'grey beard': 'we had the triangles out again last night', about 2019-2022 at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: would say, "Oh, we had the triangles out again last night."

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, passes on something he says an old hand, a "grey beard", told him about Dugway Proving Ground, a military testing site in Utah, sometime between 2019 and 2022. According to UAPGerb, this man would casually say, "Oh, we had the triangles out again last night," which, if true, would mean triangle-shaped craft fly there often enough to be routine.
